[LSER.15.1] **Every v1 series aggregation is exact.** A declaration is
satisfied by an exact backing or it is rejected, because v1 mandates
cross-platform bit-identity ([LDET.3.4]). The validator rejects a `tolerance` /
`confidence` / `delta` / `bound deterministic` / `exact` accuracy phrase
(`DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_NO_EXACT_BACKING` for `exact`).
